user.title: Connect to Blocky
user.description: Enter the address of the Blocky HTTP API. Blocky's API has no authentication, so keep its HTTP port reachable only from trusted hosts.

data_description.url: Scheme, host and port only, for example {example_url}. For the Blocky add-on use its internal hostname, such as {addon_url}.

error.invalid_url: Enter a URL with only a scheme (http or https), host and optional port. Credentials, paths and query strings are not allowed.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Blocky at this address.
error.invalid_response: The server answered, but not like a Blocky API. Check the address and that Blocky is v0.35.0 or newer.

abort.already_configured: This Blocky instance is already configured.

disable_blocking.name: Pause blocking
disable_blocking.description: Pauses Blocky's blocking for a limited time. Blocking resumes on its own afterwards.

config_entry_id.name: Blocky instance
config_entry_id.description: Which Blocky instance to pause. Only needed when more than one is configured.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to pause blocking, from 1 second to 24 hours.

groups.name: Groups
groups.description: Blocking groups to pause. Leave empty to pause all of them.

allow_domain.name: Allow domain
allow_domain.description: Adds a domain to an allow list (allow_default or lockdown_allow). Blocky reloads its lists shortly afterwards.

config_entry_id.name: Blocky instance
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Blocky instance is configured.

list.name: List
list.description: Name of one of the fixed lists: allow_default (Always allow), deny_default (Always block), restricted_deny (Restricted block list) or lockdown_allow (Lockdown allow list).

domain.name: Domain
domain.description: A domain name such as example.com. The Lockdown allow list takes exact domains only; the other lists also take a leading wildcard.

block_domain.name: Block domain
block_domain.description: Adds a domain to a block list (deny_default or restricted_deny). Blocky reloads its lists shortly afterwards.

config_entry_id.name: Blocky instance
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Blocky instance is configured.

remove_domain.name: Remove domain
remove_domain.description: Removes a domain from one of the fixed lists.

rotate_list_token.name: Rotate list token
rotate_list_token.description: Replaces the secret token in the list addresses. Blocky's configuration must be updated with the new addresses afterwards.

config_entry_id.name: Blocky instance
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Blocky instance is configured.

approve_request.name: Approve request
approve_request.description: Approves a request of a Lockdown client: the domain is added to the Lockdown allow list, which applies to every client of that level. A request can be used once.

config_entry_id.name: Blocky instance
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Blocky instance is configured.

request_id.name: Request
request_id.description: The id of the request, from the new domain event or from the list of requests.

reject_request.name: Reject request
reject_request.description: Rejects a request of a Lockdown client, which then never asks again for that client and domain. For a Restricted client it dismisses the request. A request can be used once.

config_entry_id.name: Blocky instance
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Blocky instance is configured.

request_id.name: Request
request_id.description: The id of the request, from the new domain event or from the list of requests.

block_request.name: Block request
block_request.description: Blocks the domain of a request of a Restricted client: it is added to the Restricted block list, which applies to every client of that level. A request can be used once.

request_id.description: The id of the request, from the new domain event or from the list of requests.

get_requests.name: Get requests
get_requests.description: Returns the requests waiting for a decision.

config_entry_id.name: Blocky instance
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Blocky instance is configured.

set_client_ask.name: Set whether a client asks
set_client_ask.description: Sets whether a Lockdown client turns blocked new domains into requests (on) or only causes an event (off).

config_entry_id.name: Blocky instance
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Blocky instance is configured.

client.name: Client
client.description: The IP address of a client at the Lockdown level.

ask.name: Ask me about new domains
ask.description: On: a blocked new domain becomes a request you can approve. Off: it is only reported as an unexpected domain.

database.title: Query log database
database.description: Optional. Connect to the MySQL or MariaDB database Blocky writes its query log to. Use an account that can only read: an account with write privileges is refused. Leave the host empty to switch the query log off.

data_description.db_host: Hostname or IP address of the database server.
data_description.db_password: Enter it again whenever you change these settings.

list_networks.title: Clients that may download lists
list_networks.description: Say which clients may download the rule lists from Home Assistant. Blocky downloads each list from Home Assistant. Clients, levels and rules are in the Settings tab of the HA-Blocky card, where the block to paste into Blocky is shown too.

data_description.list_networks: Networks in CIDR notation. Only clients in them can download a list. The default is the network of Home Assistant apps (add-ons).

error.db_driver_missing: No MySQL driver is installed in this Home Assistant.
error.db_cannot_connect: Could not connect to the database with these settings.
error.db_schema: This database does not contain Blocky's query log table.
error.db_not_read_only: This account can change data. Use an account that only has the SELECT privilege.
error.invalid_network: Enter networks in CIDR notation. A network that matches every address is not accepted.

no_query_log.message: No query log database is configured.

invalid_domain.message: The domain is not a valid name.
